title.en: Check in a guest with a booking

about.en: From the arrivals list: confirm the ID, take a payment and hand over the room.
about.sw: Kutoka orodha ya wanaowasili: thibitisha kitambulisho, pokea malipo na mkabidhi chumba.

steps.en: Guests arriving today wait at the top of Today. Tap Check in next to the guest.
steps.sw: Wageni wanaowasili leo wako juu kwenye Leo. Gusa Mwingize karibu na jina la mgeni.

steps.en: The booking is already filled in. Add the ID the guest shows you.
steps.sw: Taarifa za booking zimeshajazwa. Ongeza kitambulisho anachokuonyesha mgeni.

steps.en: The room is already chosen. You can still move the guest to another free room.
steps.sw: Chumba kimeshachaguliwa. Bado unaweza kumhamishia chumba kingine kilicho wazi.

steps.en: Take a payment now, or leave it for check-out. For mobile money, type the transaction code.
steps.sw: Pokea malipo sasa, au yaache hadi siku ya kuondoka. Kwa malipo ya simu, andika namba ya muamala.

steps.en: Tap Check in. The room turns occupied and the bill opens.
steps.sw: Gusa Mwingize. Chumba kinakuwa na mgeni na bili inafunguka.

about.en: Tap the items, choose how the customer pays, take the money.
about.sw: Gusa bidhaa, chagua mteja analipaje, pokea pesa.

steps.en: The counter: tap a category, then each item the customer wants.
steps.sw: Kaunta: gusa kundi, kisha kila bidhaa anayotaka mteja.

steps.en: Tap again to add one more. Switch category for food.
steps.sw: Gusa tena kuongeza moja zaidi. Badilisha kundi kwa chakula.

steps.en: The cart adds it up. Choose how the customer pays.
steps.sw: Kikapu kinajumlisha. Chagua mteja analipaje.

steps.en: Take the payment. The sale is recorded and the cart is ready for the next customer.
steps.sw: Pokea malipo. Mauzo yanarekodiwa na kikapu kiko tayari kwa mteja anayefuata.

about.en: Rooms to clean after check-out, and guests whose rooms need freshening up.
about.sw: Vyumba vya kusafisha baada ya mgeni kuondoka, na wageni ambao vyumba vyao vinahitaji kupangwa.

steps.en: Rooms to clean come first: guests have left these rooms.
steps.sw: Vyumba vya kusafisha vinaanza: wageni wameshaondoka kwenye vyumba hivi.

steps.en: When a room is clean, tap Mark ready. Reception sees it free straight away.
steps.sw: Chumba kikiwa safi, gusa Tayari. Mapokezi wanakiona kiko wazi hapo hapo.

steps.en: Guests staying: tap Freshen up when you tidy an occupied room.
steps.sw: Wageni waliopo: gusa Panga chumba unapopanga chumba chenye mgeni.

steps.en: Tap anything used or missing, like towels or the minibar. Then save.
steps.sw: Gusa chochote kilichotumika au kinachokosekana, kama taulo au minibar. Kisha hifadhi.

about.en: Orders arrive as tickets; tap each dish as you start it and when it is ready.
about.sw: Oda zinafika kama tiketi; gusa kila chakula unapoanza kukipika na kikiwa tayari.

steps.en: New orders arrive here as tickets, with how long each has waited.
steps.sw: Oda mpya zinafika hapa kama tiketi, pamoja na muda kila moja imesubiri.

steps.en: Tap a dish when you start cooking it.
steps.sw: Gusa chakula unapoanza kukipika.

steps.en: Tap it again when it is ready. The waiter is told to collect it.
steps.sw: Kiguse tena kikiwa tayari. Mhudumu anaarifiwa akichukue.

steps.en: All ready marks the rest of the ticket at once.
steps.sw: Zote tayari inatia alama tiketi iliyobaki mara moja.

steps.en: Drinks go to their own screen. Switch between Kitchen and Bar here.
steps.sw: Vinywaji vinaenda kwenye skrini yake. Badilisha kati ya Jikoni na Baa hapa.

about.en: Dates, a room from the map, the guest and an optional deposit.
about.sw: Tarehe, chumba kutoka kwenye ramani, mgeni na amana ukipenda.

steps.en: Tap New booking.
steps.sw: Gusa Booking mpya.

steps.en: Choose the arrival date and the number of nights.
steps.sw: Chagua tarehe ya kuwasili na idadi ya usiku.

steps.en: Pick a free room on the map. Taken rooms are greyed out.
steps.sw: Chagua chumba kilicho wazi kwenye ramani. Vyumba vilivyochukuliwa vimefifia.

steps.en: Type the guest's name and phone, and how the booking came in.
steps.sw: Andika jina la mgeni na simu yake, na booking imekujaje.

steps.en: Save the booking. It appears on the calendar straight away.
steps.sw: Hifadhi booking. Inaonekana kwenye kalenda hapo hapo.

about.sw: Kila chumba kwa ghorofa pamoja na hali yake: tayari, kina mgeni au kinahitaji usafi.

steps.en: Rooms shows every room by floor, with its status.
steps.sw: Vyumba inaonyesha kila chumba kwa ghorofa, pamoja na hali yake.

steps.en: Filter to see only the rooms that need cleaning.
steps.sw: Chuja uone vyumba vinavyohitaji usafi tu.

steps.sw: Vyumba na bei ina aina za vyumba vyako na bei zake.

steps.en: Tap New room type. Give it a name, a price a night and a short description.
steps.sw: Gusa Aina mpya ya chumba. Ipe jina, bei kwa usiku na maelezo mafupi.

steps.en: Tap what the room includes.
steps.sw: Gusa vilivyomo kwenye chumba.

steps.en: Add photos. Guests see them on your booking page.

steps.en: Save it. Then add the rooms of this type on the rooms tab.

title.en: The guest bill: charges, payments, check-out
title.sw: Bili ya mgeni: gharama, malipo, kuondoka

about.en: Add a minibar or restaurant charge, take a payment and check the guest out.
about.sw: Ongeza gharama ya minibar au mgahawa, pokea malipo na mtoe mgeni.

steps.en: Open a guest from In house. Their bill shows every night, charge and payment.
steps.sw: Fungua mgeni kutoka Waliopo. Bili yake inaonyesha kila usiku, gharama na malipo.

steps.en: Tap Add charge, choose what it is for and type the price.
steps.sw: Gusa Ongeza gharama, chagua ni ya nini na andika bei.

steps.en: Add it. The balance goes up straight away.
steps.sw: Iongeze. Salio linapanda hapo hapo.

steps.en: Tap Take payment, choose how the guest pays and take it.
steps.sw: Gusa Pokea malipo, chagua anavyolipa mgeni na pokea.

steps.en: With the bill settled, tap Check out. The room goes to housekeeping for cleaning.
steps.sw: Bili ikishalipwa, gusa Mtoe. Chumba kinaenda kwa wahudumu wa usafi.
